name: snaplocator-monorepo
description: SnapLocator monorepo — Chrome extension + marketing site (snaplocator.com)

scripts.build:extension: cd extension && npm run build && npm run package
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:website
scripts.install:all: cd extension && npm install && cd ../website && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd extension && npm run typecheck && cd ../website && npm run typecheck

author: The Testing Academy
